skill.name: azure-validate
skill.description: Validate Azure deployment readiness before release. The skill guides checks for azure.yaml, AZD, Bicep, Terraform, RBAC roles, policy compliance, .NET Aspire, and Azure Functions prerequisites.
skill.summary: Validate Azure deployment readiness across AZD, Bicep, Terraform, RBAC, policy, and Aspire prerequisites.
skill.author: microsoft

security_audit.summary: The static findings were reviewed in context. Most scanner hits are Markdown examples, relative documentation links, or project plan references rather than executable attacks. SKILL.md still contains authority-style prompt language and a mandatory deployment handoff, which create semantic marketplace risk.

remediation.suggestion: Remove claims such as authoritative guidance and officially verified. State that all instructions remain subject to host safety policies and user approval.
Change the azure-deploy step into an optional recommendation. Require explicit user confirmation before any deployment workflow starts.

remediation.issue: Command examples need clearer safety boundaries
remediation.suggestion: Label commands that modify local files, azd environment values, or Azure state. Tell agents to explain effects before running them.

content.value_statement: Azure deployments can fail late because configuration, policy, RBAC, or infrastructure checks were missed. This skill guides repeatable pre-deployment validation before release.
actual_capabilities: Guides readiness checks for azure.yaml, AZD, Bicep, Terraform, and Azure CLI deployments.
Provides validation steps for build checks, what-if previews, package checks, and policy review.
Checks .NET Aspire and Azure Functions prerequisites before provisioning or deployment.
Reviews infrastructure code for RBAC role assignments and least-privilege scope.
Records validation proof and status updates in the deployment plan.
Maps common Azure, AZD, Bicep, and Terraform errors to suggested fixes.
limitations: Requires an existing deployment plan from azure-prepare before normal use.
Depends on installed tools such as Azure CLI, AZD, Bicep, Terraform, Docker, or project build tools.
Needs authenticated Azure access for checks that inspect subscriptions, policies, or environment values.
Does not replace human review for cost, security, compliance, or production release approval.

use_cases.title: Check Application Readiness
use_cases.description: Run a structured validation pass before a developer asks for an Azure deployment.

use_cases.title: Review Infrastructure Changes
use_cases.description: Confirm Bicep or Terraform files compile, validate, and assign the expected Azure roles.

use_cases.title: Prepare Release Evidence
use_cases.description: Collect validation proof, policy checks, and blocker notes before a release gate.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Readiness Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Use azure-validate to check whether this project is ready for Azure deployment. Summarize blockers and required fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Validate AZD Project
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate validation for Azure Developer CLI projects.
prompt_templates.prompt: Validate this AZD project. Check azure.yaml, environment values, authentication, provision preview, build readiness, and policy requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Review Infrastructure Roles
prompt_templates.prompt: Use azure-validate to review the Bicep or Terraform infrastructure. Focus on role assignments, scopes, data-plane permissions, and least privilege.

prompt_templates.title: Full Release Gate Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the complete Azure validation workflow for this repository. Record proof, identify release blockers, and recommend whether deployment should proceed.

output_examples.input: Validate an AZD app before deployment.
output: Readiness result: blocked until authentication and location are confirmed.
The provision preview needs rerun after fixing missing environment values.

output_examples.input: Review Bicep readiness for an API service.
output: The template compiles and the what-if preview is available.
RBAC review found missing Storage Blob Data Contributor for the managed identity.
Deployment should wait until the role assignment is added and validated.

output_examples.input: Check a Terraform deployment for release.
output: Terraform format and validation checks passed.
The plan preview should be reviewed for cost and resource changes.
Policy validation remains open and must be completed before release approval.

best_practices: Run validation after planning and before any deployment workflow begins.
Confirm subscription, region, and environment names with the user before Azure checks.
Record commands, results, blockers, and fixes in the deployment plan.
anti_patterns: Do not mark a deployment as validated when checks failed or were skipped.
Do not proceed with deployment because a preview command succeeded once.
Do not widen RBAC roles or policy scope to bypass validation errors.

faq.question: What does this skill validate?
faq.answer: It validates Azure deployment readiness for configuration, infrastructure, roles, policies, build steps, and selected framework prerequisites.

faq.question: Does it deploy resources?
faq.answer: No. It is intended for validation. Deployment should require a separate user-approved workflow.

faq.question: Which tools can it reference?
faq.answer: It references Azure CLI, Azure Developer CLI, Bicep, Terraform, Docker, and Azure MCP tools when relevant.

faq.question: Does it need Azure credentials?
faq.answer: Some checks need an authenticated Azure session. Users should confirm the subscription and region before those checks run.

faq.question: Can it validate .NET Aspire projects?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes checks for Aspire projects, Container Apps environment values, and Azure Functions secret storage settings.

faq.question: Can it guarantee production safety?
faq.answer: No. It reduces deployment risk, but human review is still needed for cost, security, compliance, and release approval.
